content.text:
The real-time chat UI is complete. Here's what I built in `realtime-chat/`:

**Features:**
- **Message bubbles** — distinct styling for sent (blue) vs received, with sender names in group chats
- **Typing indicators** — animated bouncing dots + "X is typing…" text appears before auto-replies
- **Online status** — green/yellow/gray dots on avatars, live status changes every 15s
- **Emoji picker** — 8 categories (😀❤️👍🐱🍕⚽🚗💡), click-to-insert
- **Multiple channels** — 2 group chats + 2 DMs pre-populated, searchable sidebar
- **New channel creation** — modal to add custom group channels
- **Unread badges** — badge counts on channels with new messages
- **Auto-replies** — simulated responses from other users when you send a message
- **Incoming messages** — random messages appear in non-active channels periodically
- **Dark theme** — polished dark UI with CSS custom properties

Open `realtime-chat/index.html` in a browser to try it out.
